Quick sizing + performance knobs from SE side:
- For median 512, baseline 8 GPUs should be fine with continuous batching and prefix caching. Expect steady-state throughput around 90–110 rps depending on request shape.
- If Lyra can accept an INT8 quantized build for the POC, we can reduce GPU count by ~30% (so 6 GPUs for baseline), but need to validate output quality vs their eval set. Latency improves ~15–25% in many cases.
- KV cache & warmup: recommend pre-warming cache for the first 48 hours of the pilot; this reduces spike tail latency.
- Autoscaling: enable conservative burst policy to bring up third pod only when sustained >120 rps for 10+ minutes.

I'll draft a 1-page technical MOP with the quantization tradeoff summary to attach. If they push for cost savings, this is the quickest lever.

Karthik Iyer
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
